enriched_activities.desc: Remain lying in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Breathe regularly. Turn to right side. Move legs. Pull blanket down. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Breathe deeply. Turn to back. Move arm under pillow. Remain motionless.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up in bed. Swing legs out of bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Splash water on face. Apply soap to face. Rub face. Rinse face with water. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth with water. Wipe face with towel. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast, making coffee with the kettle
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs, bread, milk. Close refrigerator. Take out frying pan. Place pan on induction cooker. Turn on induction cooker. Crack eggs into pan. Fry eggs. Insert bread into toaster. Turn on toaster. Pour milk into glass. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Pour hot water into mug. Add coffee powder. Stir coffee. Sit at table. Eat eggs and toast. Drink coffee.

enriched_activities.activity: Changing into work uniform and packing work bag
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out work uniform. Take off sleepwear. Put on uniform shirt. Button shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open drawer. Take out work bag. Open bag. Put stethoscope into bag. Put notebook and pen into bag. Put phone into bag. Put keys into bag. Put wallet into bag. Close bag. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for the day shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Check bus schedule on phone. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Pay fare with card. Find seat. Sit down. Put bag on lap. Look out window. Check phone messages. Get off bus. Walk to hospital entrance. Enter hospital. Walk to locker room.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, attending to patients and clinical duties
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at nurses station. Review patient charts. Check patient 1 vitals. Administer medication to patient 1. Talk to patient 1. Update patient 1 records. Move to patient 2. Check patient 2 vitals. Administer medication to patient 2. Talk to patient 2. Update patient 2 records. Attend team meeting. Discuss patient cases. Return to nurses station. Answer phone call. Respond to patient call button. Assist patient 3 with mobility. Document care. Wash hands.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break at the hospital cafeteria
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Choose food items. Place food on tray. Pay at cashier. Find table. Sit down. Eat food. Drink beverage. Talk to colleague. Clear tray. Return tray to designated area. Walk out of cafeteria.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing clinical duties and handing over patient notes
enriched_activities.desc: Return to nurses station. Review patient notes. Check patient 4 vitals. Administer medication to patient 4. Talk to patient 4. Update patient 4 records. Prepare handover notes. Review handover notes with colleague. Discuss patient status. Hand over patient notes to next shift. Answer phone call. Respond to patient call button. Assist patient 5 with dressing change. Document care. Wash hands. Clean equipment. Restock supplies.

Walk to bus stop. Check bus schedule on phone. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Pay fare with card. Find seat. Sit down. Put bag on lap. Check phone messages. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter home. Close door.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner using the induction cooker and refrigerator
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables, meat, sauce. Open cabinet. Take out cutting board and knife. Place cutting board on counter. Cut vegetables. Cut meat. Take out wok. Place wok on induction cooker. Turn on induction cooker. Add oil to wok. Add meat to wok. Stir meat. Add vegetables to wok. Stir vegetables. Add sauce. Stir. Turn off induction cooker. Transfer food to plate.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner and loading the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Pick up plate. Stand up. Walk to sink. Scrape food scraps into trash. Open dishwasher. Place plate in dishwasher. Place utensils in dishwasher. Close dishwasher. Turn on dishwasher. Wipe table with cloth. Put cloth away.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and changing into casual clothes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rub body. Rinse body. Wash hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel around body. Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out casual clothes. Put on casual clothes.

enriched_activities.activity: Vacuuming and tidying the living room
enriched_activities.desc: Enter living room. Pick up vacuum cleaner. Plug in vacuum cleaner. Turn on vacuum cleaner. Vacuum floor. Move furniture to vacuum under. Vacuum under furniture. Turn off vacuum cleaner. Unplug vacuum cleaner. Put vacuum cleaner away. Pick up items from floor. Place items in storage. Arrange pillows on sofa. Wipe coffee table with cloth. Put cloth away.

Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Select channel. Watch TV. Change channel. Adjust volume. Get up to get snack. Return to sofa. Eat snack. Watch TV. Check phone. Continue watching TV. Turn off TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer to check messages and review the next day's schedule
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open email. Check messages. Reply to messages. Open calendar. Review next day's schedule. Make notes. Close email. Open document. Review patient notes. Close computer. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Night routine, washing up before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet face. Apply cleanser. Rub face. Rinse face. Dry face with towel. Apply moisturizer. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.

Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Breathe regularly. Turn to right side. Move legs. Pull blanket down. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Breathe deeply. Turn to back. Move arm under pillow. Remain motionless.
